title: TlachIA Metrics: Unified Scientometric Indicators Calculation Engine for OpenAlex
description: TlachIA Metrics is a scientometric intelligence platform and analytical engine designed to construct customized OpenAlex corpuses and compute a comprehensive suite of indicators covering scientific production, citation impact (FWCI, citation percentiles), Diamond Open Access, APC economics, collaboration networks, and knowledge taxonomies.
